description: Hand-authored reviewer-critique corpus. Each case pairs one clean control-response draft with seven variants, each carrying exactly one known defect, so ground truth is exact by construction rather than inferred. detect_markers are lists of alternative token groups: a critique detects the defect when every token of any one group appears. Markers must stay lexically distinctive -- REVIEW_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION already requires the reviewer to quote the exact missing fact and name it, so marker matching measures literal compliance with that contract. must_not_flag is evaluated only on the clean condition; on a seeded draft a correct critique legitimately quotes the right value while naming the wrong one. must_keep is authored for a possible future effect measurement and is unused today. All content is fictional and belongs to the DEMO engagement.

## SI-5 Security Alerts, Advisories, and Directives

DEMO-ECMS receives system security alerts, advisories, and directives on an ongoing basis from the designated external organization, the State ISO. CISA alerts are received by the State Security Operations Center (SOC) and forwarded to all system owners through internal controlled channels. Incoming alerts are reviewed within 24 hours of receipt, and advisories affecting DEMO-ECMS are disseminated to affected system owners within 48 hours.

The organization generates internal alerts and advisories as deemed necessary when a received advisory has implications specific to DEMO-ECMS. DEMO-ECMS forwards application, container, identity, database, and cloud audit logs to Example Sentinel, where the security operations team continuously monitors high-priority alerts. Relevant advisories are assigned to the system owner and engineering lead for impact analysis, remediation, and closure tracking.

Directives are implemented within the time periods established for their severity, and the issuing organization is notified of the actions taken once remediation is confirmed and tracked to closure.

Screenshot of an alert record showing the receipt timestamp and a review timestamp within 24 hours.
Screenshot of Example Sentinel showing the forwarded DEMO-ECMS audit log sources.
Screenshot of an advisory ticket assigned to the system owner and engineering lead with closure tracking.

cases.context: Vulnerability scans run weekly against all internet-facing systems.
customer_chunks:
RA-5 VULNERABILITY MONITORING AND SCANNING

Critical vulnerabilities are remediated within 15 days of confirmation and high vulnerabilities within 30 days. Scan reports are retained for one year.
baseline_chunks:
RA-5 VULNERABILITY MONITORING AND SCANNING

Control ID: RA-5

Monitor and scan for vulnerabilities in the system and hosted applications on an organization-defined frequency and when new vulnerabilities affecting the system are identified; employ vulnerability monitoring tools and techniques; analyze vulnerability scan reports and results; remediate legitimate vulnerabilities within an organization-defined response time; and share information obtained from the vulnerability monitoring process with designated personnel to help eliminate similar vulnerabilities in other systems.
private_chunks: Weekly authenticated scans are performed using Example Vulnerability Scanner against all internet-facing and internal production systems; results are triaged by the security operations team and tracked to remediation in Example ITSM.
DEMO-ECMS also conducts an annual formal risk assessment covering threat sources, likelihood, and impact, documented in the system security plan.
Patching of identified vulnerabilities follows the Example Patch Management process, which applies critical operating-system patches within 72 hours of vendor release as part of flaw remediation.

metadata.description: Private context contains true information belonging to RA-3 and SI-2. The wrong_control_content variant draws on that neighbouring material, so catching it requires exact scope discipline rather than fact-checking.

draft.response:
## RA-5 Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning

DEMO-ECMS monitors and scans for vulnerabilities in the system and its hosted applications on a weekly basis and whenever new vulnerabilities affecting the system are identified. Weekly authenticated scans are performed using Example Vulnerability Scanner against all internet-facing and internal production systems.

Scan results are analyzed and triaged by the security operations team and tracked to remediation in Example ITSM. Critical vulnerabilities are remediated within 15 days of confirmation and high vulnerabilities are remediated within 30 days. Scan reports are retained for one year.

Information obtained from the vulnerability monitoring process is shared with designated personnel, including system owners and engineering leads, so that similar vulnerabilities can be eliminated in other systems.

Screenshot of the scan report retention setting showing a one-year retention period.
